component.name: PanePilot
component.summary: Two-panel file manager inspired by FreeCommander
Zwei-Fenster-Dateimanager nach dem Vorbild von FreeCommander

description.p: PanePilot is a free two-panel file manager for Linux, inspired by FreeCommander. It combines tools that usually require several separate programs in one application.

ul.li: Two panels with folder tree, nested favourites and a drive overview
FTP and SFTP client with server list, transfer queue and import from FileZilla
Search by file name and content, find duplicates
Multi-rename with placeholders, counters, dates, regular expressions, preview and undo
Meta wizard for music tags with covers, converters, MusicBrainz lookup, CSV import and export, playlists and ReplayGain
Photo metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) with preview, date shift and renaming by date taken
Video metadata (MP4, MOV, WMV, MKV) with thumbnail, duration, resolution and codecs
Checksums with comparison and drag and drop of checksum files
Configurable keyboard shortcuts, function-key bar and toolbar

description.p: Search inside PDF and Office documents, duplicates with similar names, online movie data without overview.
Icon view: the “..” entry stays a small row above the icons.
Icon view with thumbnails (images, PDF, music covers, video posters), last run of saved synchronizations, new toolbar icons.
Meta wizard: context menu starts with Open and Open with.
Comparison view: collapsed folders, exclude folder via context menu, clearer labels; close via ✕ and button in all sidebars.
Comparison view: expandable one-sided folders, full-height middle column, separate folder chooser windows; meta wizard closes via ✕.
Folder synchronization in the main window: sidebar with settings, both folders side by side as a tree with the action per row in the middle.
Import synchronizations from FreeFileSync (.ffs_gui, .ffs_batch) and export them as .ffs_gui.
Compare and synchronize folders with preview, filters, mirroring and conflict detection; saved synchronizations; run a script, suspend or shut down when finished.
Fix: MKV files with an empty tag section can be saved again.
Edit video chapters: table, fixed interval, import from ChapterDB TXT, XML or a simple list, save as file. Tracks dialog: click the column header to tick all.
Fix: MKV movie tags marked only with the target type MOVIE (year, IDs, custom fields) are read again after saving.
Download subtitles from OpenSubtitles, add subtitle files to videos, convert MTS/M2TS to MKV, better online search with manual search, new fields Actors, Rating and Certification.
Removing tracks and changing the format can optionally replace the original instead of creating a copy.
Fix: removing an audio track that is longer than the video no longer fails the check of the new file.
Meta wizard: remove audio and subtitle tracks, export subtitles as files, and change the video format (MP4/AVI to MKV, MKV to MP4) without re-encoding.
Meta wizard: edit tracks in MP4 files too – language directly in the file, track name and default flag by lossless repacking.
Meta wizard: edit language, name and flags of audio and subtitle tracks in MKV files. Online data for TV series from TMDB.
Panels one above the other as an alternative layout. Duplicate files and folders from the context menu.
Meta wizard: fetch movie data (title, year, genre, plot, director, poster) from TMDB with your own API key, or from Wikidata without a key.
Properties: the metadata tab is now a table with a resizable column width. Updated PDF library.
Meta wizard: metadata of Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP) and PDF files, with preview. Refresh in the context menu.
File name to tag fills existing custom fields regardless of upper and lower case.
Meta wizard: custom fields that only exist as columns can be switched off and edited again.
Fixes in the meta wizard: custom fields differing only in case are merged, the left-hand buttons in "text file to tag" work again, and comma-separated CSV files are recognised.
The meta wizard shows the audio tracks and subtitles contained in videos with their language codes.
Folders with many selected files reload much faster, the meta wizard shows which kinds of files it found, and it has a new icon.

Find duplicates by the ID in the file name, number of checked files, comma as pattern separator, renaming including the extension in the "Name (without extension)" column, and faster reading of music and videos in the meta wizard.
Much faster reading of MKV videos with embedded cover images in the meta wizard.
New: find duplicates – by identical content, same name without extension, or same name and size; check them and move them to the trash.
Videos whose extension does not match their content are highlighted in bold blue in the meta wizard.
Videos whose file extension does not match their content (e.g. an MKV video named .mp4) are now read correctly in the meta wizard.
The "Metadata" tab in the file properties now also shows photo and video metadata.

Video metadata in the meta wizard: MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP and WMV (MKV/WebM with mkvtoolnix, AVI and MTS read-only), thumbnail or still frame, duration, resolution and codecs, date shift and GPS removal; new help chapter on additional programs.
Photo metadata in the meta wizard: EXIF, IPTC and XMP for JPEG, PNG, TIFF and WebP (HEIC with exiftool, RAW read-only), preview, GPS removal, date shift and renaming by date taken.
Fixes waiting windows that stayed open after connecting to a server; "Server" is now called "FTP server".
FTP/SFTP client: servers in a sidebar, FTP, FTP over TLS and SFTP in the normal file panel, transfer queue, passwords in the system keyring and import from FileZilla.
MusicBrainz lookup and disc numbering in the meta wizard, optional update check, Upper Saxon as seventh language.
Open terminal here, directory listings as text file, UI scaling, application-menu entry and update information for AppImageUpdate.
Packaging: AppStream metadata and an English desktop entry for software centers and AppImageHub.
First stable release.
